title: Real-Time Human Trajectory Prediction from RGB-D for Mobile Robots Using Bi-Mamba
abstract: arXiv:2610.33916v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting the short-term future trajectory of a person from RGB-D cameras is a key capability for mobile robots navigating in dynamic and human populated environment. The key challenge to deploying learned predictors on real robots is the train-deploy pipeline gap. Training data are often prepared with an idealized, smoothed ground truth, whereas at inference, the model is fed noisy estimates from pose detectors and depth sensors. The model is therefore evaluated on an input distribution it never encountered during training. Most existing models rely on recurrent neural networks (RNNs) or transformers, which either struggle to capture short-term temporal dependencies or suffer from computational cost. We present TrajMamba, a lightweight, bidirectional state space model for short-term human trajectory prediction using an RGB-D camera. translated_title: 基于Bi-Mamba的移动机器人RGB-D实时人体轨迹预测
translated_abstract: 从RGB-D相机预测人的短期未来轨迹，是移动机器人在动态且人群密集环境中导航的关键能力。将学习到的预测器部署到真实机器人上的核心挑战在于训练与部署流程之间的差距：训练数据通常是基于理想化、平滑处理后的真值准备的，而在推理阶段，模型接收的却是来自人体姿态检测器和深度传感器的含噪估计。因此，模型实际上是在一个训练时从未遇到过的输入分布上被评估的。现有的大多数模型依赖于循环神经网络（RNN）或Transformer，前者难以捕捉短期时间依赖性，后者则存在计算成本高的问题。我们提出了TrajMamba，一种轻量级的双向状态空间模型，用于基于RGB-D相机的短期人体轨迹预测。该模型在训练和部署中使用单一的共享处理路径，对齐人体姿态……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出TrajMamba——一种轻量级双向状态空间模型，通过统一的训练-部署共享处理路径弥合训练数据与真实部署传感器噪声之间的差距，实现移动机器人基于RGB-D相机的实时短期人体轨迹预测。
en_tdlr: We present TrajMamba, a lightweight bidirectional state space model that uses a single shared processing path for both training and deployment to bridge the train-deploy pipeline gap, enabling real-time short-term human trajectory prediction from RGB-D cameras for mobile robots.
